title: Share task state across linked worktrees
body: Resolve harness friction #50 by making TaskStore use the same primary-worktree-aware root resolution as PlanStore and adding regression coverage.

log.text: Share task state across linked worktrees
Aligning TaskStore root resolution with PlanStore primary-worktree behavior and adding linked-worktree regression coverage.
Moved primary_worktree resolution into the shared task module, made TaskStore use it, and added linked-worktree parity coverage; plan suite passes.
